DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書の欄が読みにくいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the application form difficult to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。眼鏡を忘れてしまいました。少し文字を大きくして見られる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眼鏡を忘れ申請書を見る道具を借りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I forgot my glasses. Is there anything that lets me see the letters a little larger?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you forgot your glasses and ask to borrow something to read the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 窓口用の拡大鏡があります。この机でお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have a magnifying glass for the counter. Please use it at this desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 助かります。今の住所を書くのは、この太い枠の中ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拡大鏡を使い住所欄を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That helps. My current address goes inside this thick border, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the magnifier and check the address field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。その下には連絡先の電話番号を書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Write your contact telephone number underneath.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書けました。番号が枠から少しはみ出しましたが、書き直した方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話番号のはみ出しを示して書き直しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written it. The number goes slightly outside the box; should I rewrite it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the phone number extending outside the box and ask about rewriting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読めますので、そのままで大丈夫です。お名前の欄もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's readable, so it's fine as it is. Fill in the name too, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前も書きました。拡大鏡を置いて、記入した内容を確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前記入後に読み取れるか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written my name. I'll put down the magnifier; could you check what I've entered?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After entering your name, ask whether the entries can be read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所と電話番号は読めています。こちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The address and phone number are legible. I'll take the form here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。拡大鏡はこちらの台に戻します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 申請書を渡し拡大鏡を返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll put the magnifier back on this stand. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the form and return the magnifier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かに戻していただきました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've returned it, thank you. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カーテンを閉めかけて、止めたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You started closing the curtain, then stopped?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。酸素の管がカーテンの端に引っ掛かっています。動かすのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 酸素の管がカーテンへ引っ掛かった状況を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The oxygen tube is caught on the edge of the curtain. I'm worried about moving it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the oxygen tube caught on the curtain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 触らずにいてくださってありがとうございます。管の位置を見ますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for not touching it. I'll check the tube's position.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベッドの右側です。食事の時は平気でしたが、今は少し引かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右側の位置と引かれる感覚の発生時を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's on the right side of the bed. It was fine during the meal, but now it feels slightly pulled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the right-side position and when the pulling began. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで位置を整えます。鼻の所に痛みや違和感はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll adjust its position. Is there pain or discomfort around your nose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鼻は痛くありません。管が頬に当たっている感じはあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鼻の痛みの有無と頬の当たり方を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My nose doesn't hurt. I do feel the tube pressing against my cheek.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain no nose pain and how it touches the cheek. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 頬の部分も確認します。カーテンはこちらで閉めますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the cheek part too. I'll close the curtain for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。着替えるので、入口から見えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着替えのため入口側のカーテンを閉めてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'm changing, so I don't want to be visible from the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to close the entrance-side curtain for changing clothes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管に余裕を持たせて閉めました。今の当たり方はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've closed it with slack in the tube. How does it feel now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 楽になりました。着替えが終わったら、開ける時も呼んでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 改善を伝え着替え後の開閉も手伝ってほしいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's more comfortable. After changing, can I call you to help open it too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report improvement and ask for help opening it after changing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、呼んでください。では、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please call. I'll leave you now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨夜の音についてのお話ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about last night's noise, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。夜中の一時ごろ、家の前で大きな破裂音が三回しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜中一時ごろの三回の破裂音を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Around one in the morning, there were three loud bangs outside my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain three loud bangs around one in the morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 音の後に、何か見えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you see anything after the noise?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 窓から煙が見えました。道路に人が二人いましたが、何をしていたかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 煙と二人を見たが行為は見ていないと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saw smoke from the window. Two people were on the road, but I didn't see what they were doing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish seeing smoke and two people from not seeing their actions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: けが人や、燃えている物はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Were there injured people or anything burning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その時は見えませんでした。朝になると、道路に紙の筒が落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当時の状態と朝に見た紙の筒を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I couldn't see any at the time. In the morning, there was a paper tube lying on the road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe what you could see then and the paper tube seen in the morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を地図で示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you point to the place on a map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この角です。写真も撮りましたが、筒は触らずそのままにしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 場所と写真を示し落下物に触れていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: This corner. I took photographs too, but haven't touched the tube and left it where it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the place and photos and say you haven't touched the object. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を拝見します。昨夜の人物について覚えていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll look at the photos. Do you remember anything about those people last night?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 暗くて服や顔は分かりません。音がした時刻は、スマートフォンの記録で確かめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人物不明と時刻の確認方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: It was dark, so I couldn't make out their clothes or faces. I checked the time of the noises using my phone's records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain unknown identities and how you verified the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。お話を伺いました。ご協力ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We've heard your account. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの筒をお送りになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ポスターが入っています。両端のふたを閉めた状態で測ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ふたを閉じたポスター筒の計測を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It contains a poster. Could you measure it with both end caps closed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request measurement of the poster tube with the caps closed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 長さは六十二センチです。中のポスターは動きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's 62 centimeters long. Does the poster move inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し動きます。ふたに当たると端が折れそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中で動いて端が折れそうな状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: A little. If it hits the cap, the edge might crease.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the movement inside and possible creasing of the edge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空いた部分を紙で押さえると、動きが少なくなります。梱包台をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Holding the empty space with paper reduces movement. Please use the packing table.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家から持ってきた薄い紙を詰めます。ポスターに直接テープを貼る必要はないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参紙で隙間を埋める方法とテープ位置を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll fill it with the thin paper I brought from home. I don't need to put tape directly on the poster, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm filling the gap with your paper and where tape goes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。筒のふたの方をしっかり留めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Secure the tube caps firmly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 中の隙間を埋めて、ふたを留めました。これで重さを測ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 梱包後の計量を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've filled the gap and secured the caps. Please weigh it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request weighing after packing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 五百グラムです。このサイズの送り方は、こちらに二つ載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: 500 grams. Two shipping methods for this size are listed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料金を比べると、この方法でよさそうです。これで送り、控えをください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提示された方法を選び発送控えを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Comparing the prices, this method looks fine. Please send it that way and give me a receipt copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the presented method and request the dispatch receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。控えをお渡しします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Here's your copy. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ATMからお戻りになったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've come back from the ATM, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。現金は出ましたが、明細の紙が出ませんでした。出金できたか記録で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現金は出たが明細が出ず取引記録を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The cash came out, but no transaction slip. I'd like to check the records to confirm the withdrawal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you got the cash but no slip and want to check the transaction record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出金された金額と、ご利用のATMを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me the withdrawal amount and which ATM you used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二万円です。入口に近い左側の機械を、五分ほど前に使いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出金額機械位置利用時刻を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: 20,000 yen. I used the machine on the left near the entrance about five minutes ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the amount, machine location, and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現金とカードは、お手元に戻っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have both the cash and your card back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、二万円とカードはあります。画面には紙切れと表示されたと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金カードの返却と紙切れ表示を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I have the 20,000 yen and card. I think the screen said it was out of paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm cash and card return and report the out-of-paper message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取引の確認方法をご案内します。通帳はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain how to check the transaction. Do you have your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。出金の行を記帳して、金額を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参通帳に出金を記帳して見たいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'd like the withdrawal printed in it so I can see the amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to update the passbook you brought and view the withdrawal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記帳機へご案内します。今の取引はこちらの行です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take you to the updating machine. This line is the transaction just now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二万円の出金になっていますね。紙が出ない機械のことも、担当の方へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二万円の出金を確かめ機械の紙切れ連絡を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It shows a 20,000-yen withdrawal. Please also tell the staff about the machine that didn't issue paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the 20,000-yen withdrawal and ask to report the machine's paper shortage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通帳をお返しします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Here's your passbook back. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの玉ねぎは、一つの袋に入っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: These onions are in one bag, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。赤い玉ねぎ一個と、普通の玉ねぎ二個です。値段が違うので分けた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ袋の赤玉ねぎ一個と普通二個の別会計を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. One red onion and two regular onions. Their prices differ; should they be separated?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about separate pricing for one red and two regular onions in one bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで分けて数えます。赤い物は一個百二十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll separate them for counting. The red ones are 120 yen each.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普通の物は一個七十円の札が付いていました。その値段で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 普通玉ねぎの表示価格を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The regular ones had a 70-yen-each tag. Is that price correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the displayed regular-onion price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、七十円を二個で百四十円です。玉ねぎの合計は二百六十円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Two at 70 yen is 140 yen. The onions total 260 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 合っています。袋はそのまま一つで使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 玉ねぎ合計を確認し一つの袋を使いたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's correct. I'd like to keep using the same single bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the onion total and request one bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、会計後に一緒にお入れします。他の商品もこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then we'll put them together after payment. Shall I ring up the other goods here too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。卵だけは玉ねぎの上に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 卵を上に置く袋詰めを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please just put the eggs on top of the onions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request packing the eggs on top. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 卵を一番上にしてお入れしました。お会計は全部で六百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've put the eggs at the very top. Everything totals 600 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 六百円を払います。袋の持ち手を二つまとめて持ちますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 総額を払い袋の持ち方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay 600 yen. I'll hold both bag handles together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay the total and explain how you will carry the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。卵に気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Take care of the eggs on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 卓球台をお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you using the table-tennis table?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも風で球が流れるので、今日は打ち合いが難しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 風で卓球ができない状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but the wind carries the ball away, so playing looks difficult today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the wind prevents playing table tennis. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この台は屋外なので、風の影響がありますね。球を拾う時は通路を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This table is outdoors, so the wind affects it. Watch the path when retrieving balls.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう二回、通路へ転がりました。室内の台はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 球の転がりを説明し室内台の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has rolled onto the path twice already. Are there any indoor tables?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the rolling ball and ask about indoor tables. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 室内にはありません。ラケットと球は、この受付に返せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: None indoors. You can return the rackets and balls at this reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら卓球はやめて、友人と散歩します。球が一個、台の下に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 卓球をやめ散歩へ変更し台下の球を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then we'll stop playing and walk with my friend. One ball is under the table.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Change from table tennis to a walk and report the ball under the table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 下にある物はこちらで拾いました。貸出しの球はこれでそろいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've picked up the one underneath. All the loan balls are accounted for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ラケット二本も返します。散歩は池の方へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ラケット二本返却と池へ行く希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll return the two rackets too. We'd like to walk toward the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Return two rackets and say you want to go to the pond. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 池へは左の園路です。奥の橋の先は工事で通れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Take the park path on the left to the pond. You can't pass beyond the far bridge because of construction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、橋の手前まで行って戻ります。道具を受け取っていただいてありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 工事を避け橋の手前で戻る経路を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then we'll go as far as before the bridge and return. Thank you for taking the equipment back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a route turning back before the bridge to avoid construction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お預かりしました。散歩を楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we've received it. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。乗り換えまで十五分あるので、お弁当を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗り換え待ち十五分で弁当購入を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have fifteen minutes until my transfer, so I'd like to buy a boxed meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a boxed meal during your fifteen-minute transfer wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この改札の中には売店がありません。外の店をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is no shop inside these ticket gates. I can direct you to one outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この乗車券で、途中の駅として一度外へ出られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車券で一度改札外へ出られるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Can I leave the gates once at this intermediate station using this ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether your ticket allows one exit through the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券を拝見します。この券では、ここで出ると先の区間は使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see it. With this ticket, if you exit here, you can't use the remaining section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうですか。買物のために切符を買い直すほどの時間はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符買い直しの時間がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I see. I don't have enough time to buy another ticket just for shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not have time to repurchase a ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ホームの飲料販売機でしたら、改札内で使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use the platform drinks machine inside the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では飲み物だけ買います。お弁当は着いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 改札内で飲料購入し弁当を到着後へ延期する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll buy only a drink. I'll get a boxed meal after arriving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Buy a drink inside the gates and postpone the meal until arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の列車は四番線です。販売機は、その待合室の横にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your next train is on Track 4. The machine is beside that waiting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四番線へ行き、そこで飲み物を買って待ちます。教えてくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四番線の販売機と待つ場所を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go to Track 4, buy a drink there, and wait. Thank you for telling me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the Track 4 machine and where to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の返戻についてご連絡を受けた方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you contacted about a returned envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。市からの封筒が宛先不明で戻ったと、電話をいただきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 市の封筒が返戻されたという電話の用件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. You phoned to say an envelope from the city was returned because the addressee couldn't be found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the phone call about a returned city envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前と、封筒を送った時点の住所を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I have your name and the address at the time the envelope was sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 高田です。先月までは東町三番地でしたが、今は東町八番地です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名と旧住所新住所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Takada. Until last month it was 3 Higashimachi, but now it's 8 Higashimachi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your name, old address, and new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 転居の届出は、もうお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you already registered the move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先週済ませました。送付先が変わる前に出された封筒でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居届提出時を伝え発送日との関係を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did last week. Was the envelope sent before the delivery address changed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the move-notification date and ask about its relation to dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発送記録では、届出の前日に旧住所へ出しています。本人確認後にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The record says it went to the old address the day before your notification. We'll hand it over after checking your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらが確認書類です。封筒の中に返事の期限があるので、ここで開けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人確認書類を示し期限確認のため開封を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here's my identification. There is a reply deadline inside, so I'd like to open it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show identification and request opening to check the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。横の記入台をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Go ahead. Use the writing table beside us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来週までの返信でした。新しい住所を返信用紙にも書いて、今日中に返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返信期限を読み新住所を記して返す行動を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The reply is due by next week. I'll put the new address on the reply form too and return it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read the deadline and decide to write your new address and reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 封筒をお受取りいただきました。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've received the envelope. Goodbye, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袖が濡れているのですね。腕をそのままにしていてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your sleeve is wet, I see. Keep your arm as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。さっきから点滴の近くが冷たく感じて、袖を見ると濡れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 点滴近くの冷たさと濡れた袖を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It felt cold near the IV just now, and when I looked my sleeve was wet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report coldness near the IV and a wet sleeve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 痛みや、腫れた感じはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Any pain or feeling of swelling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し張る感じがあります。強い痛みはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 張る感覚と痛みの程度を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It feels a little tight. There isn't strong pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain tightness and the degree of pain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで点滴と腕の状態を確認します。いつ気づきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the IV and arm. When did you notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二、三分前です。水をこぼしたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 気づいた時刻と水をこぼしていない事実を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two or three minutes ago. I haven't spilled water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give when you noticed and state that you did not spill water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 点滴はいったんこちらで止めます。袖を確認できるよう、上着を開けますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll stop the IV for now. I'll open your jacket so we can check the sleeve.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。右手だけではファスナーを下げにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 上着のファスナー操作の手伝いを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. The zipper is difficult to lower with only my right hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request help operating your jacket zipper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開けました。濡れた所を押さえず、この姿勢で少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's open. Don't press on the wet part; wait in this position a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。濡れた上着は、確認が終わったら着替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指示姿勢を了承し確認後の着替えを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. After the check, I'd like to change the wet jacket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the instructed position and request changing after the check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 着替えもお手伝いします。まず腕を確認しますね。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll help you change too. First I'll check the arm. Excuse me.
